description: list shows them. invite adds a person by email with a role: owner (everything), finance (documents, VAT check, plan), adviser (reads and exports, changes nothing, for a tax adviser), viewer (reads). They sign in by email link. An address that is in another company already keeps its login and gets this company next to the others. role changes a role, remove takes someone out. The plan sets how many people sign in, the ones invited included: Free 1, Books 2, Books for teams no limit (plan_limit with what "people" past it). Admins and owners only, except list.

action.description: list (default) shows the people, invite adds one, role changes a role, remove takes someone out

member_id.description: role and remove: the person, from list
